what_is_demonstrated.claim: every score this detector produces is a sum of integer table contributions, can be taken apart residue by residue and by descriptor family, and the parts add back to the same number at machine precision
what_is_demonstrated.why_this_is_structural_and_not_a_perform: a sequence encoder's score is not a sum over interpretable parts and cannot be decomposed this way at any accuracy. That is a difference in what the two constructions are, and it is the only comparative statement near this appendix that no measurement contradicts

what_is_not_demonstrated.not_that_geometry_beats_statistics: candidates are outputs, not comparisons, and the comparison that was run goes the other way: pLM-NN leads this detector by 0.0243 on the official fold and 0.0340 on the frozen external set

no_esr1_accuracy_number.why: the pilot that would supply one declares itself invalidated
no_esr1_accuracy_number.reason: Labels were built by ligand resname only, merging every crystallographic ligand copy (e.g. 4Q50 OHT 232 heavy atoms ~= 8 copies), so DCA could match the wrong copy. The label builder is now chain/instance-scoped (pdb_io.ligand_heavy_coords, with regression test). Every number below (Foliation/fpocket/P2Rank/random, incl. P2Rank 6/6) is NOT citable until labels are regenerated per chain and all methods re-run.
no_esr1_accuracy_number.what_still_stands: a decomposition is an algebraic identity and needs no labels: the score equals the sum of its parts whether or not the residue is a pocket. The identity stands while the pilot's accuracy does not

input.selection_rule: of the 100 ESR1 records screened (the 25 lowest-numbered of each modality), the small molecules passing every hard clause of the audit -- identity fields reproduce, no stability alert, modality label supported by the structure, no undefined stereocentre -- ordered by ascending synthetic step proxy and then by identifier, first six taken. 44 of the 100 pass those clauses, and the rule re-derives the six from the identifiers alone
input.why_two_chemotypes: four of the six are triarylethylenes and two are quinazolinones, and that mixture is not curated -- it is what the ordering produced. It is worth seeing: the same triarylethylene signature the companion repository flags as WRONG under a FLT3 label is CORRECT here, because a tamoxifen-class skeleton belongs to a nuclear-receptor ligand-binding domain and not to a kinase hinge. One rule, one substructure, opposite verdicts by target

topological_pharmacophore.units: bonds along the shortest path in the molecular graph
topological_pharmacophore.why_topological: no binding mode is asserted anywhere in this repository, so a conformational distance would be a claim this work does not support. A graph geodesic is a property of the constitution

structural_audit.why_carried_not_recomputed: the audit's rule tables -- stability motifs, metabolic routes, liability families, chemotype signatures -- live in one place in the companion repository and are covered by its tests. Duplicating a SMARTS table into this repository would create two copies that can drift, and a drifted screen is worse than an absent one. So the verdict travels as pinned input with the commit that produced it, and this repository recomputes only what needs no rule table: canonical SMILES, InChIKey, formula, the bond graph, the topological pharmacophore and the stereocentres, all of which are RDKit primitives

non_claims: no affinity, potency, selectivity or efficacy is measured or predicted
no toxicity in any organism is measured or predicted; the audit reports that no pattern from its named rule families matched, which is a different statement
no binding mode, pose or docking score is asserted
no accuracy number for ESR1 is offered: the pilot that would supply one declares itself invalidated
this molecule demonstrates nothing about the detector's accuracy; the detector's decomposability is what the appendix is for

topological_pharmacophore.units: bonds along the shortest path in the molecular graph
topological_pharmacophore.why_topological: no binding mode is asserted anywhere in this repository, so a conformational distance would be a claim this work does not support. A graph geodesic is a property of the constitution

structural_audit.why_carried_not_recomputed: the audit's rule tables -- stability motifs, metabolic routes, liability families, chemotype signatures -- live in one place in the companion repository and are covered by its tests. Duplicating a SMARTS table into this repository would create two copies that can drift, and a drifted screen is worse than an absent one. So the verdict travels as pinned input with the commit that produced it, and this repository recomputes only what needs no rule table: canonical SMILES, InChIKey, formula, the bond graph, the topological pharmacophore and the stereocentres, all of which are RDKit primitives

non_claims: no affinity, potency, selectivity or efficacy is measured or predicted
no toxicity in any organism is measured or predicted; the audit reports that no pattern from its named rule families matched, which is a different statement
no binding mode, pose or docking score is asserted
no accuracy number for ESR1 is offered: the pilot that would supply one declares itself invalidated
this molecule demonstrates nothing about the detector's accuracy; the detector's decomposability is what the appendix is for

topological_pharmacophore.units: bonds along the shortest path in the molecular graph
topological_pharmacophore.why_topological: no binding mode is asserted anywhere in this repository, so a conformational distance would be a claim this work does not support. A graph geodesic is a property of the constitution

defined_double_bond_geometry.note: a defined geometry on a fully substituted alkene; setting it is the hardest step in this scaffold class

structural_audit.why_carried_not_recomputed: the audit's rule tables -- stability motifs, metabolic routes, liability families, chemotype signatures -- live in one place in the companion repository and are covered by its tests. Duplicating a SMARTS table into this repository would create two copies that can drift, and a drifted screen is worse than an absent one. So the verdict travels as pinned input with the commit that produced it, and this repository recomputes only what needs no rule table: canonical SMILES, InChIKey, formula, the bond graph, the topological pharmacophore and the stereocentres, all of which are RDKit primitives

non_claims: no affinity, potency, selectivity or efficacy is measured or predicted
no toxicity in any organism is measured or predicted; the audit reports that no pattern from its named rule families matched, which is a different statement
no binding mode, pose or docking score is asserted
no accuracy number for ESR1 is offered: the pilot that would supply one declares itself invalidated
this molecule demonstrates nothing about the detector's accuracy; the detector's decomposability is what the appendix is for

defined_double_bond_geometry.note: a defined geometry on a fully substituted alkene; setting it is the hardest step in this scaffold class

structural_audit.why_carried_not_recomputed: the audit's rule tables -- stability motifs, metabolic routes, liability families, chemotype signatures -- live in one place in the companion repository and are covered by its tests. Duplicating a SMARTS table into this repository would create two copies that can drift, and a drifted screen is worse than an absent one. So the verdict travels as pinned input with the commit that produced it, and this repository recomputes only what needs no rule table: canonical SMILES, InChIKey, formula, the bond graph, the topological pharmacophore and the stereocentres, all of which are RDKit primitives

non_claims: no affinity, potency, selectivity or efficacy is measured or predicted
no toxicity in any organism is measured or predicted; the audit reports that no pattern from its named rule families matched, which is a different statement
no binding mode, pose or docking score is asserted
no accuracy number for ESR1 is offered: the pilot that would supply one declares itself invalidated
this molecule demonstrates nothing about the detector's accuracy; the detector's decomposability is what the appendix is for

structural_audit.why_carried_not_recomputed: the audit's rule tables -- stability motifs, metabolic routes, liability families, chemotype signatures -- live in one place in the companion repository and are covered by its tests. Duplicating a SMARTS table into this repository would create two copies that can drift, and a drifted screen is worse than an absent one. So the verdict travels as pinned input with the commit that produced it, and this repository recomputes only what needs no rule table: canonical SMILES, InChIKey, formula, the bond graph, the topological pharmacophore and the stereocentres, all of which are RDKit primitives

non_claims: no affinity, potency, selectivity or efficacy is measured or predicted
no toxicity in any organism is measured or predicted; the audit reports that no pattern from its named rule families matched, which is a different statement
no binding mode, pose or docking score is asserted
no accuracy number for ESR1 is offered: the pilot that would supply one declares itself invalidated

topological_pharmacophore.units: bonds along the shortest path in the molecular graph
topological_pharmacophore.why_topological: no binding mode is asserted anywhere in this repository, so a conformational distance would be a claim this work does not support. A graph geodesic is a property of the constitution

defined_double_bond_geometry.note: a defined geometry on a fully substituted alkene; setting it is the hardest step in this scaffold class

structural_audit.why_carried_not_recomputed: the audit's rule tables -- stability motifs, metabolic routes, liability families, chemotype signatures -- live in one place in the companion repository and are covered by its tests. Duplicating a SMARTS table into this repository would create two copies that can drift, and a drifted screen is worse than an absent one. So the verdict travels as pinned input with the commit that produced it, and this repository recomputes only what needs no rule table: canonical SMILES, InChIKey, formula, the bond graph, the topological pharmacophore and the stereocentres, all of which are RDKit primitives
